title: Graduate Geotechnical / Civil Engineer | Transport | Melbourne
content_text:
Mott MacDonald Graduate Geotech/Civil Engineers Transport Market Melbourne (apply.mottmac.com), verified 5 Oct 2026.
Graduate program focusing on geotechnical / civil engineering on road and rail transport infrastructure, with some Defence exposure. APNA graduate program with workshops and mentoring. Commence February 2027. Must be currently studying a Civil Engineering degree and able to complete studies before commencing February 2027. Applicants must hold Australian Citizenship. Submit resume and cover letter as one document. Screening begins immediately; role may close prior to deadline.
apply_instructions: Apply via Mott MacDonald careers portal with resume and cover letter as one document: https://apply.mottmac.com/job/Docklands-Graduate-Civil-Engineer-Transport-Melbourne%2C-VIC-VIC/1368618957/
